feeds.title: Dreamer's Church Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Dreamer's Church, your passionate church near me in the heart of Austin! We believe that you were uniquely created to dream and that God has a transformative plan for your life. As a vibrant Christian community, we are dedicated to seeing broken dreamers restored and renewed through the love of God. Our mission is to help you grow and pursue God, one step at a time. Experience the joy of worship, genuine community, and the life-changing teachings that will empower you to live out your God-given dreams.

Antioch Austin is a non-denominational Christian church located in central Austin, Texas with ministries for kids, youth, college students and young adults.

feeds.title: Texas Values Blog
feeds.description: Texas Values is a nonprofit organization that supports faith, family, and freedom in Texas. Their mission is to preserve and promote family values in Texas. Their vision is to ensure that Texas is a state where religious liberty flourishes, families prosper, and every human life is valued.
